feasibility.reason: All three selected corpora expose relations and endpoint graphs; relation-conditioned spline messages can be evaluated directly.
No corpus provides validated future graph-state densities, critical-host compromise horizons, or action-conditioned transitions.
APA and raw Edge events are ordered; APA provides source-disjoint benign/attack streams for anytime evidence and stopping.
Missing/deceptive telemetry and hidden attacker states must be simulated; particle belief accuracy can be tested only under declared masks.
Structured feature/protocol/intensity perturbations are feasible, but observed attacker action distributions and rewards are absent.
Graphs can be condensed, but logged response outcomes and Bellman targets are absent; only detector/rare-class retention is testable.
Desktop CPU/GPU timings support a hardware-proxy search only; no target edge device or measured energy is available.
Endpoint, relation, and feature hypervectors plus online prototype updates are directly implementable; action quality remains simulated.
No defensible continuous attack-state derivatives, containment inputs, or controlled propagation equations are present.
Multiple corpora form environments, but only binary labels and coarse graph statistics reconcile without inventing mechanisms.
